subtopic: INT4 KV cache / Aggressive KV quantization
learningObjective: Identify the trade-offs of INT4 KV cache quantization vs INT8/FP8 for LLM serving.
stem: Which of the following statements about aggressive INT4 KV cache quantization (relative to FP16 or INT8 KV) are TRUE? (Select all that apply.)
profileData:
KV cache footprint (LLaMA-70B, 8K context, batch=1, per token):
  FP16 KV: ~2.5 MB per token → 20 GB per request
  INT8 KV: ~1.25 MB per token → 10 GB per request
  INT4 KV: ~0.65 MB per token (INT4 + per-token FP16 scales) → 5.2 GB per request

Long-context QA benchmark (Needle-in-a-Haystack, 32K context, LLaMA-13B):
  FP16 KV  : baseline accuracy
  INT8 KV  : ≈ FP16 - 0.4%
  INT4 KV  : ≈ FP16 - 2.1%

Kernel support:
  vLLM 0.5+: INT8/FP8 KV production; INT4 KV experimental (dequant-in-register to FP16).
  TensorRT-LLM 0.9+: INT8/FP8 KV production; INT4 KV in preview.

options.text: Kernel support for INT4 KV attention is less mature than for INT8/FP8; some production stacks support INT4 for KV storage only, dequantizing to FP16 in the attention kernel.
INT4 KV cache is always at least as accurate as INT8 KV cache because more scale factors are needed and are stored per-token.
INT4 KV halves the KV memory footprint again vs INT8 (4× vs FP16), enabling substantially longer contexts or higher batch sizes on the same GPU memory.

INT4 KV quantization accuracy is more sensitive to context length than INT8 KV because the coarser quantization step amplifies softmax's cumulative sensitivity; long-context QA / retrieval-heavy benchmarks show larger drops than at INT8.

explanation: Options A, C, D are correct; option B is incorrect. A (Correct): kernel-support maturity. B (Wrong): fewer bits = less precision, regardless of scale count. C (Correct): footprint arithmetic. D (Correct): sensitivity to context length grows with quantization coarseness.

optionExplanations.B: Wrong: fewer bits = less precision, regardless of scale count.
optionExplanations.D: Correct: sensitivity to context length grows with quantization coarseness.

assumptions: Per-token or per-head-per-token scaling for KV quantization.
Standard attention kernel with configurable KV dtype.
nonImplications: Does not imply INT4 KV is unusable — it works for many workloads at modest accuracy cost.
Does not imply INT4 KV always yields the theoretical 2× speedup over INT8; kernel overhead and metadata reduce the effective gain.

distractorRationales.B: Overestimates the effect of scale count.
